name: HiGS Macro-tile Rasterization
definition: A rasterization technique using macro-tiles (8x4 or 8x8 render tiles) to decouple work distribution from screen area, enabling resolution-stable frame times by bounding per-unit work.
summary: HiGS Macro-tile Rasterization is a GPU-accelerated technique for 3D Gaussian Splatting that groups tiles into macro-tiles to decouple work distribution from screen area, reducing partitioning bottlenecks at high resolutions.
